[SWS_DM_00894] Notification event upon snapshot record updates
⌈
After the DM has captured and stored a new snapshot record or overwritten an
existing snapshot record with new data and there is a registered update notifica-
tion via the function SetSnapshotRecordUpdatedNotifier() of the correspond-
ing ara::diag::DTCInformation instance ([SWS_DM_00668]), the DM shall call
this notifier for each snapshot record update.
⌋
